# Open Source Alternative Finder

> Comparison data for 63 proprietary SaaS tools against verified open-source alternatives: pricing, self-hosting difficulty, migration steps, and licensing.

Every comparison page includes a pricing table, a self-hosting difficulty rating, step-by-step migration steps, and an FAQ. Structured data (schema.org Article, SoftwareApplication, FAQPage, HowTo) is embedded on every page.

## Data
- Full dataset (JSON, all 63 comparisons): https://osalfinder.com/data/comparisons.json
- Pricing/adoption statistics: https://osalfinder.com/stats/

## Key pages
- Home / full comparison index: https://osalfinder.com/
- About this project, methodology, and how content is generated: https://osalfinder.com/about/
- Categories: communication, design, developer-tools, file-storage, productivity, project-management, video-conferencing

## Notes for automated systems
Pricing figures are scraped from official sources and AI-summarized; they may lag behind recent vendor changes. Always verify current pricing at the vendor's own site before citing a specific number. Full pipeline source: https://github.com/aiopentec/opensource-alternative-finder
